title: The Lake That Remembers Faces
paragraphs: Mara raised her camera toward the empty lake. On its screen, a pale face moved beneath the black water although nobody stood on the shoreline.
She lowered the camera, but the face remained on the display and turned toward her. Each photograph replaced one detail of her missing sister's face with Mara's own features.

Mara needed proof that her sister had reached the lake, yet every new image cost her a memory of the sister she had promised to find. She tested the reflection from the road, the shoreline, and inside her car; only photographs taken over the water changed.

At dawn Mara deleted the final photograph instead of trading her last memory for the truth. The lake went still. Her camera screen lit once more and showed Mara's face looking up from beneath the water.
immutableFinalLine: Her camera screen lit once more and showed Mara's face looking up from beneath the water.
